description: This file defines the RouteCollector class in the Slim PHP framework, responsible for collecting and managing routes and route groups, generating paths and URLs, handling route caching, and route lookup functionalities.

classes.name: RouteCollector
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting routes and route groups, managing route cache, and providing route lookup and group functionalities within the Slim framework.

methods.name: getRouteParser
methods.description: Returns the route parser instance used by the collector.

methods.name: getDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the default route invocation strategy.

methods.name: setDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the default route invocation strategy.

methods.name: getCacheFile
methods.description: Gets the path to the route cache file, if set.

methods.name: setCacheFile
methods.description: Sets the route cache file path, validating access permissions.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base path used in URL generation.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path used in URL generation.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns the list of all collected routes.

methods.name: removeNamedRoute
methods.description: Removes a route identified by its name.

methods.name: getNamedRoute
methods.description: Retrieves a route by its name.

methods.name: lookupRoute
methods.description: Finds a route by its identifier.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a route group with a shared pattern.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Helper to instantiate a new RouteGroup.

methods.name: createProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy for route group collection.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Adds a new route with specified HTTP methods, pattern, and handler.

methods.name: createRoute
methods.description: Creates a Route object with given methods, pattern, and handler.
